meta.title: Trek of Discovery - 2
meta.description: As we ascend, the light shines burning, the path we sought now wholly illuminated.

units.rawText: Prepare to be judged, Daemon!
units.displayText: Prepare to be judged, Daemon!

spans.text: Prepare to be judged, Daemon!

units.rawText: Skree—
units.displayText: Skree—

spans.text: Skree—

units.rawText: Patience's long sword stabs into the Low-Order Entropic's body, but the Entropic clings to Patience even in death.
units.displayText: Patience's long sword stabs into the Low-Order Entropic's body, but the Entropic clings to Patience even in death.

spans.text: Patience's long sword stabs into the Low-Order Entropic's body, but the Entropic clings to Patience even in death.

units.rawText: Persicaria, who has been watching from a corner, breathes a sigh of relief as the Entropic and the Sanctifier go dormant.
units.displayText: Persicaria, who has been watching from a corner, breathes a sigh of relief as the Entropic and the Sanctifier go dormant.

spans.text: Persicaria, who has been watching from a corner, breathes a sigh of relief as the Entropic and the Sanctifier go dormant.

units.rawText: Antonina, I've reached the first target location.
units.displayText: Antonina, I've reached the first target location.

spans.text: Antonina, I've reached the first target location.

units.rawText: I'm glad you're okay, Persicaria. When your transmission suddenly cut off just now I...
units.displayText: I'm glad you're okay, Persicaria. When your transmission suddenly cut off just now I...

spans.text: I'm glad you're okay, Persicaria. When your transmission suddenly cut off just now I...

units.rawText: It's okay. I encountered a small Entropic patrol, but It's safe now. Tell me what to do next.
units.displayText: It's okay. I encountered a small Entropic patrol, but It's safe now. Tell me what to do next.

spans.text: It's okay. I encountered a small Entropic patrol, but It's safe now. Tell me what to do next.

units.rawText: Whew... We studied the data you sent back and found a lot of special environmental codes on this battlefield.
units.displayText: Whew... We studied the data you sent back and found a lot of special environmental codes on this battlefield.

spans.text: Whew... We studied the data you sent back and found a lot of special environmental codes on this battlefield.

units.rawText: Special environmental codes?
units.displayText: Special environmental codes?

spans.text: Special environmental codes?

units.rawText: From their names, they all seem to be some kind of Sanctifier structure... Like say, those "Watchtowers" we've seen before.
units.displayText: From their names, they all seem to be some kind of Sanctifier structure... Like say, those "Watchtowers" we've seen before.

spans.text: From their names, they all seem to be some kind of Sanctifier structure... Like say, those "Watchtowers" we've seen before.

units.rawText: So you're saying that the objective point where I am right now is...
units.displayText: So you're saying that the objective point where I am right now is...

spans.text: So you're saying that the objective point where I am right now is...

units.rawText: That's right. It was once a Sanctifier Watchtower and also where the data is most chaotic... If you activate the Overwrite Program in places like these, you can guarantee a successful installation.
units.displayText: That's right. It was once a Sanctifier Watchtower and also where the data is most chaotic... If you activate the Overwrite Program in places like these, you can guarantee a successful installation.

spans.text: That's right. It was once a Sanctifier Watchtower and also where the data is most chaotic... If you activate the Overwrite Program in places like these, you can guarantee a successful installation.

units.rawText: Even if you don't install any programs, just moving around in these places will mess up their data since you're foreign to this world. That will give us more room to work with.
units.displayText: Even if you don't install any programs, just moving around in these places will mess up their data since you're foreign to this world. That will give us more room to work with.

spans.text: Even if you don't install any programs, just moving around in these places will mess up their data since you're foreign to this world. That will give us more room to work with.

units.rawText: Understood. I'll head over to the designated locations and activate the Overwrite Program there.
units.displayText: Understood. I'll head over to the designated locations and activate the Overwrite Program there.

spans.text: Understood. I'll head over to the designated locations and activate the Overwrite Program there.

units.rawText: Please, please be careful. There are still many Entropics at those coordinates. Remember, fall back immediately if you run into danger!
units.displayText: Please, please be careful. There are still many Entropics at those coordinates. Remember, fall back immediately if you run into danger!

spans.text: Please,
please
be careful. There are still many Entropics at those coordinates. Remember, fall back immediately if you run into danger!

units.rawText: Got it!
units.displayText: Got it!

spans.text: Got it!

units.rawText: Persicaria crouches down and warily moves toward her next objective. This area is littered with Entropic and Sanctifier corpses, and there are no words to describe this carnage.
units.displayText: Persicaria crouches down and warily moves toward her next objective. This area is littered with Entropic and Sanctifier corpses, and there are no words to describe this carnage.

spans.text: Persicaria crouches down and warily moves toward her next objective. This area is littered with Entropic and Sanctifier corpses, and there are no words to describe this carnage.

units.rawText: ...Even though I know this is only data of the past, this is still...
units.displayText: ...Even though I know this is only data of the past, this is still...

spans.text: ...Even though I know this is only data of the past, this is still...

units.rawText: Purple and gold operands slowly rise up from the corpses, like stardust.
units.displayText: Purple and gold operands slowly rise up from the corpses, like stardust.

spans.text: Purple and gold operands slowly rise up from the corpses, like stardust.

units.rawText: This should be the objective point... There's only one Entropic signal up ahead; While it's still unaware...
units.displayText: This should be the objective point... There's only one Entropic signal up ahead; While it's still unaware...

spans.text: This should be the objective point... There's only one Entropic signal up ahead; While it's still unaware...

units.rawText: Persicaria gathers her operands at her fingertip and leans out, then fires an operand blast at her target.
units.displayText: Persicaria gathers her operands at her fingertip and leans out, then fires an operand blast at her target.

spans.text: Persicaria gathers her operands at her fingertip and leans out, then fires an operand blast at her target.

units.rawText: Oh no, it wasn't enough!
units.displayText: Oh no, it wasn't enough!

spans.text: Oh no, it wasn't enough!

units.rawText: Graaahhh!!!!
units.displayText: Graaahhh!!!!

spans.text: Graaahhh!!!!

units.rawText: The attacked Entropic immediately sends its tentacles towards Persicaria.
units.displayText: The attacked Entropic immediately sends its tentacles towards Persicaria.

spans.text: The attacked Entropic immediately sends its tentacles towards Persicaria.

units.rawText: Persicaria narrowly evades the attack and gathers operands in her hand again for another attack.
units.displayText: Persicaria narrowly evades the attack and gathers operands in her hand again for another attack.

spans.text: Persicaria narrowly evades the attack and gathers operands in her hand again for another attack.

units.rawText: Grahhhh!!!
units.displayText: Grahhhh!!!

spans.text: Grahhhh!!!

units.rawText: But how?!
units.displayText: But how?!

spans.text: But how?!

units.rawText: (My attacks... They can't pierce its carapace?)
units.displayText: My attacks... They can't pierce its carapace?

spans.text: My attacks... They can't pierce its carapace?

units.rawText: <size=40>Crash—</size>
units.displayText: Crash—

spans.text: Crash—

units.rawText: The Entropic's attack strikes home on Persicaria's location, but Persicaria is nowhere to be found.
units.displayText: The Entropic's attack strikes home on Persicaria's location, but Persicaria is nowhere to be found.

spans.text: The Entropic's attack strikes home on Persicaria's location, but Persicaria is nowhere to be found.

units.rawText: Antonina, my attacks... they aren't working on that Entropic.
units.displayText: Antonina, my attacks... they aren't working on that Entropic.

spans.text: Antonina, my attacks... they aren't working on that Entropic.

units.rawText: Hm... Let me see if I can alter the values... Hm.. That's not working... if I changed the parameters here...
units.displayText: Hm... Let me see if I can alter the values... Hm.. That's not working... if I changed the parameters here...

spans.text: Hm... Let me see if I can alter the values... Hm.. That's not working... if I changed the parameters here...

units.rawText: (This is only the first area, but I've already encountered such powerful Entropics... I doubt things will go smoothly in the subsequent locations...)
units.displayText: This is only the first area, but I've already encountered such powerful Entropics... I doubt things will go smoothly in the subsequent locations...

spans.text: This is only the first area, but I've already encountered such powerful Entropics... I doubt things will go smoothly in the subsequent locations...

units.rawText: (If only I had more operands...)
units.displayText: If only I had more operands...

spans.text: If only I had more operands...

units.rawText: (Professor... What would you do at a time like this...)
units.displayText: Professor... What would you do at a time like this...

spans.text: Professor... What would you do at a time like this...

units.rawText: Suddenly, Persicaria seems to remember something and takes out the Overwrite Program that Antonina gave her.
units.displayText: Suddenly, Persicaria seems to remember something and takes out the Overwrite Program that Antonina gave her.

spans.text: Suddenly, Persicaria seems to remember something and takes out the Overwrite Program that Antonina gave her.

units.rawText: (The Overwrite Program... lots of operands... effective attack methods... In that case...)
units.displayText: The Overwrite Program... lots of operands... effective attack methods... In that case...

spans.text: The Overwrite Program... lots of operands... effective attack methods... In that case...

units.rawText: Persicaria? What are you doing? Wait a minute, are you going to—
units.displayText: Persicaria? What are you doing? Wait a minute, are you going to—

spans.text: Persicaria? What are you doing? Wait a minute, are you going to—

units.rawText: Persicaria takes a deep breath.
units.displayText: Persicaria takes a deep breath.

spans.text: Persicaria takes a deep breath.

units.rawText: System Command; Password: nosugarnocoffee!
units.displayText: System Command; Password: nosugarnocoffee!

spans.text: System Command; Password: nosugarnocoffee!

units.rawText: Remove data buffer zone restrictions and connect to Overwrite Program!
units.displayText: Remove data buffer zone restrictions and connect to Overwrite Program!

spans.text: Remove data buffer zone restrictions and connect to Overwrite Program!

units.rawText: You dummy! Don't connect directly to the Overwrite Program! Forced compatibility mode will cause too much strain for your neural cloud!
units.displayText: You dummy! Don't connect directly to the Overwrite Program! Forced compatibility mode will cause too much strain for your neural cloud!

spans.text: You dummy! Don't connect directly to the Overwrite Program! Forced compatibility mode will cause too much strain for your neural cloud!

units.rawText: However, Persicaria pays Antonina's advice no heed. Instead, she continues establishing a connection to the Overwrite Program.
units.displayText: However, Persicaria pays Antonina's advice no heed. Instead, she continues establishing a connection to the Overwrite Program.

spans.text: However, Persicaria pays Antonina's advice no heed. Instead, she continues establishing a connection to the Overwrite Program.

units.rawText: The discomfort from forced compatibility mode tears at Persicaria's neural cloud and the pain leaves her unable to speak.
units.displayText: The discomfort from forced compatibility mode tears at Persicaria's neural cloud and the pain leaves her unable to speak.

spans.text: The discomfort from forced compatibility mode tears at Persicaria's neural cloud and the pain leaves her unable to speak.

units.rawText: Ahhhhhhh! Okay, I've got it! Just wait for me for 30 seconds! Neumann, help me out here!
units.displayText: Ahhhhhhh! Okay, I've got it! Just wait for me for 30 seconds! Neumann, help me out here!

spans.text: Ahhhhhhh! Okay, I've got it! Just wait for me for 30 seconds! Neumann, help me out here!

units.rawText: Gagah!
units.displayText: Gagah!

spans.text: Gagah!

units.rawText: The Entropic finally acquires its prey again and eagerly charges toward Persicaria.
units.displayText: The Entropic finally acquires its prey again and eagerly charges toward Persicaria.

spans.text: The Entropic finally acquires its prey again and eagerly charges toward Persicaria.

units.rawText: (I need to counterattack... come on, work already...)
units.displayText: I need to counterattack... come on, work already...

spans.text: I need to counterattack... come on, work already...

units.rawText: Compatibility failed.
units.displayText: Compatibility failed.

spans.text: Compatibility failed.

units.rawText: Retry.
units.displayText: Retry.

spans.text: Retry.

units.rawText: Compatibility failed.
units.displayText: Compatibility failed.

spans.text: Compatibility failed.

units.rawText: Ignore all errors below Class L1 and retry!
units.displayText: Ignore all errors below Class L1 and retry!

spans.text: Ignore all errors below Class L1 and retry!

units.rawText: Compatibility successful. Initiating Overwrite Program. Operand transfer connection established.
units.displayText: Compatibility successful. Initiating Overwrite Program. Operand transfer connection established.

spans.text: Compatibility successful. Initiating Overwrite Program. Operand transfer connection established.

units.rawText: Now! Persicaria!
units.displayText: Now! Persicaria!

spans.text: Now! Persicaria!

units.rawText: Upon hearing Antonina's voice, Persicaria opens her hand and familiar equipment appears in Persicaria's vicinity.
units.displayText: Upon hearing Antonina's voice, Persicaria opens her hand and familiar equipment appears in Persicaria's vicinity.

spans.text: Upon hearing Antonina's voice, Persicaria opens her hand and familiar equipment appears in Persicaria's vicinity.

units.rawText: GRAHH!!!!!!
units.displayText: GRAHH!!!!!!

spans.text: GRAHH!!!!!!

units.rawText: Operands pierce through the Entropic's body.
units.displayText: Operands pierce through the Entropic's body.

spans.text: Operands pierce through the Entropic's body.

units.rawText: Huh? This is...
units.displayText: Huh? This is...

spans.text: Huh? This is...

units.rawText: Honestly, the Overwrite Program would have torn you to bits if Neumann and I hadn't offloaded part of the calculations in time.
units.displayText: Honestly, the Overwrite Program would have torn you to bits if Neumann and I hadn't offloaded part of the calculations in time.

spans.text: Honestly, the Overwrite Program would have torn you to bits if Neumann and I hadn't offloaded part of the calculations in time.

units.rawText: Antonina... Thank you...
units.displayText: Antonina... Thank you...

spans.text: Antonina... Thank you...

units.rawText: The Entropic distorts, and then evaporates into ash.
units.displayText: The Entropic distorts, and then evaporates into ash.

spans.text: The Entropic distorts, and then evaporates into ash.

units.rawText: To think you'd connect the Overwrite Program to your combat modules... (Sighs) I did my best to keep it in as familiar a form as possible.
units.displayText: To think you'd connect the Overwrite Program to your combat modules... (Sighs) I did my best to keep it in as familiar a form as possible.

spans.text: To think you'd connect the Overwrite Program to your combat modules... (Sighs) I did my best to keep it in as familiar a form as possible.

units.rawText: Yeah. After all, this isn't the first time I've had to bear large operand loads in the black hole.
units.displayText: Yeah. After all, this isn't the first time I've had to bear large operand loads in the black hole.

spans.text: Yeah. After all, this isn't the first time I've had to bear large operand loads in the black hole.

units.rawText: Ah... You mean, during the ENIAC incident...
units.displayText: Ah... You mean, during the ENIAC incident...

spans.text: Ah... You mean, during the ENIAC incident...

units.rawText: (Sigh) I don't even know what to say about you.
units.displayText: (Sigh) I don't even know what to say about you.

spans.text: (Sigh) I don't even know what to say about you.

units.rawText: Thank you, Antonina. Let's go to the next location to start up the Overwrite Program.
units.displayText: Thank you, Antonina. Let's go to the next location to start up the Overwrite Program.

spans.text: Thank you, Antonina. Let's go to the next location to start up the Overwrite Program.
